parsed.scene_description: The image shows the interior of a modern library or bookstore. The focal point of the image is a large wooden bookshelf with multiple rows of books neatly arranged on the shelves. The shelves are filled with books of different sizes and colors. On the right side of the shelf, there is a circular light fixture hanging from the ceiling. In the foreground, there are two people sitting at a desk with laptops and other items on it. The person on the left is wearing a white jacket and appears to be working on one of the laptops. The background shows a large window with a view of trees and buildings outside. The floor is made of concrete and there are several potted plants scattered around the room. The overall atmosphere of the space is bright and airy.
